acceptance: One documented dialect source feeds SQL and DataFrame loaders
pandas NULL group keys match SQL grouping semantics
description: Deferred from the independent adversarial review of flightdata-cross-surface-output-contract-burn-down (C3/C4): (1) SQL and DataFrame loaders resolve CSV dialects through separate paths (benchmark attributes vs manifest), so the same manifest metadata is interpreted in two places — consolidate on a single dialect source; (2) pandas groupby drops NULL group keys while SQL keeps NULL groups, so unmatched LEFT JOIN codes diverge on real data — align with dropna=False or equivalent after verifying Dask/cuDF support. Neither triggers on the synthetic gate data.
